picked.t: Vietnam welcomes HKU Business School plan to establish Hanoi campus
picked.body: Deputy Prime Minister Le Tien Chau met Prof. Hongbin Cai, dean of the University of Hong Kong (HKU) Business School, in Hanoi on Oct. 20 to discuss the proposal and strengthen academic cooperation. Chau praised HKU's international standing and the contributions of its representative office in Vietnam, which has helped secure more than US$4.7 million in scholarships for Vietnamese students since 2022 and provided training in AI management and digital transformation for a high-level National Assembly delegation. He said developing high-quality human resources is one of Vietnam's three strategic breakthroughs, while the Politburo has called for stronger international cooperation and investment in higher education. Chau welcomed the plan to establish an HKU Business School campus in Hanoi as a platform for international business education and research. He noted that the government has set out conditions for foreign higher education institutions to establish branch campuses in Vietnam. He proposed a phased approach, beginning with joint training programs with reputable Vietnamese universities or pilot courses to assess demand before expanding enrollment and proceeding with the investment and licensing procedures for a full campus. Chau also called for broader academic collaboration, including inviting HKU faculty to teach and supervise doctoral students in Vietnam, conducting joint research, co-authoring scientific publications and commercializing research results. Other proposals included increasing scholarships, supporting the training of Vietnamese lecturers and education managers, and creating priority admission arrangements for outstanding Vietnamese students and young scientists. Potential cooperation areas include artificial intelligence, data science, semiconductors, green finance, financial technology, business administration and public health.

picked.t: [베트남 주간 이슈] SK 원유 터지고 UOB VN성장률 9.2% 상향…베트남, 모빌리티·디지털 타고 거침없는 질주
picked.body: 싱가포르 UOB가 베트남의 올해 경제성장률 전망치를 9.2%로 대폭 끌어올렸다. 빈패스트가 25개월 연속 시장 1위를 지키며 북미·아시아 모빌리티 영토를 넓히는 가운데, SK어스온은 베트남 광구에서 첫 원유를 뿜어내며 6,000만 배럴 자원 확보의 물꼬를 텄다.  하지만 베트남은 빠른 성장 만큼 명암도 짙어지고 있다. 1㎡당 5,000만 원에 달하는 초호화 아파트 열풍으로 주거 빈부격차가 극에 달하고, 건기철 하노이의 대기오염은 세계 상위권을 기록하며 성장통을 드러냈다.  베트남 주간 경제·산업 동향 포인트 3가지 빈패스트 및 전기차·이륜차 중심의 모빌리티 영토 확장 빈패스트가 25개월 연속 시장 1위를 기록한 데 이어 미국 전기버스 플랫폼 출시 및 필리핀 신형 SUV 예약 개시, 자회사 GSM의 북미 진출 등 글로벌 공략에 속도를 내고 있다. 국내외 완성차 수요가 급증하는 가운데 내연기관 규제와 친환경 전환 기조가 뚜렷해지고 있다. 디지털 인프라 연동 의무화 및 IT·에너지 분야 한·베 협력 심화 정부가 연내 증권·이커머스·SNS 등 12개 분야의 VNeID 연동을 의무화하며 디지털 통제를 강화하는 한편, SK어스온의 국내 광구 첫 원유 생산, 롯데이노베이트의 데이터센터 협력 등 다방면의 공급망·인프라 연계가 강화되고 있다. 부동산 양극화 심화 및 환경·대기질 악화 우려 하노이 아파트 분양 시장의 흡수율이 저조한 반면 초고가 아파트 열풍이 불며 양극화가 심화되고 있고, 하노이의 대기오염이 세계 상위권에 오르며 건기철 환경 이슈가 주요 현안으로 부각됐다. ■ 정치·정책 '디지털 신원 연동 및 생활 규제 강화' 베트남 정부는 증권, 이커머스, SNS 등 12개 주요 분야에 대해 연내 VNeID(국가 디지털 신원) 연동을 의무화하여 온라인 투명성과 보안을 강화한다. 담배위해예방통제법에 따라 술집과 노래방 등 실내 흡연을 전면 금지하는 방안이 추진된다. ■ 매크로 '신차·이륜차 호조 및 경제 성장 상향' 9월 신차 판매량이 전월 대비 38% 급증하는 등 자동차 수요가 강세를 보이며 연간 50만 대 육박 및 사상 최고치 경신 기대감이 커지고 있다. 오토바이 및 전기이륜차 시장이 동반 성장하며 9월 기준 이륜차 총 누적 대수가 300만 대를 돌파했고 휴대폰 수출도 전년 동기 대비 20% 증가했다. ■ 산업·경제 'UOB 성장률 상향 및 숙련 인력난' 싱가포르 UOB는 베트남의 올해 경제성장률 전망치를 기존 8.5%에서 9.2%로 대폭 상향 조정했다. 반면 기업 10곳 중 5곳이 숙련 인력 채용의 어려움을 호소하고 있어 인적 자원 미스매치가 과제로 지적됐다. ■ 기업 '빈패스트 글로벌 확장 및 글로벌 IT 행보' 빈패스트는 9월 2만 3000여 대를 판매해 25개월 연속 시장 1위를 지켰으며, 미국 전기버스 플랫폼 출시 및 필리핀 SUV 예약 개시 등 해외 진출을 본격화했다. 마이크로소프트는 베트남 R&D 인력을 대거 감축했으나 장기적 투자는 지속하겠다는 입장을 밝혔다. ■ 금융·부동산 '암호화폐 급성장과 초고가 아파트 열풍' 베트남 암호화폐 시장 규모가 연간 1,220억 달러로 동남아 2위를 기록한 반면, 하노이 아파트 분양 시장은 3분기 흡수율이 31%에 그치는 등 엇갈린 양상을 보였다. 1㎡당 5,000만 원에 달하는 초호화 아파트와 브랜드레지던스(1만 6,000여 세대, 세계 3위) 열풍이 불며 주거 빈부격차가 심화되고 있다. ■ 하노이·호치민시 '보행교 완공 및 대기오염 문제' 호치민시는 21일 사이공강 양안을 연결하는 보행교 완공 했으며, 하노이는 건기철 진입과 함께 세계 3위의 불명예스러운 대기오염 수치를 기록하며 대책 마련이 시급해졌다. ■ 인프라 '까마우공항 재개장 및 롱탄신공항 점검' 폐쇄 1년여 만에 개보수를 마친 최남단 까마우공항이 다음 달 재개장하며, 12월 개항을 앞둔 롱탄신공항은 항행장비 비행검사 등 주요 시스템 점검에 돌입했다. ■ 사회 '세계 최고 쌀 선정 및 관광 비자 완화' 베트남 쌀 품종 ST25가 '2026년 세계 최고의 쌀' 2위에 선정되었고, 러시아와 중국(냐짱 방문 단체관광객) 대상 무비자 및 비자 면제 조치가 확대되었다. ■ 한-베 이슈 'SK 원유 생산 및 다방면 경제·문화 교류' SK어스온이 베트남 광구에서 첫 원유 생산을 개시하며 6,000만 배럴 자원 확보의 발판을 마련했고, 롯데이노베이트의 데이터센터 사업 확대 및 현대엔지니어링·SK이노베이션의 기후·생태계 복원 사업이 마무리되었다. 하노이 '한국 미식주간' 개최와 봉화군의 이용상 왕자 정착 800주년 기념행사 등 양국 간 문화·인적 교류도 깊어지고 있다.

picked.t: EU provides $11.2M to extend Hanoi metro line
picked.body: The proposed 11-km section is planned to run entirely underground, in conjunction with transit-oriented development (TOD). The Hanoi People’s Committee, in coordination with the French government, the French Development Agency (AFD), the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and the European Investment Bank (EIB), held a commemorative plaque unveiling ceremony for Line 3 at Cau Giay Station (S8) on the Nhon–Hanoi Station line on Oct. 19. The event recognized the results of cooperation between Hanoi, the French government and international financial institutions in developing public transport infrastructure, while opening up prospects for further expansion of the capital's urban railway network. According to information released by the partners at the event, the EU has entrusted AFD with managing a 10-million-euro grant to support preparations for extending Metro Line 3 from Hanoi Station to Hoang Mai. The Hanoi People's Committee signed the support program in 2024, and the Hanoi Metropolitan Railway Management Board (MRB), a public agency under the Hanoi People's Committee responsible for planning, managing, and executing the capital's urban railway network, is implementing it, with preparatory activities expected to be completed by the end of 2027. The extension is planned to be approximately 11 km long and run entirely underground in the southern part of the capital. The grant will fund a feasibility study, transit-oriented development planning along the route, research into traffic organization and multimodal connectivity solutions, and efforts to strengthen project implementation capacity. Integrating urban railway development with TOD planning is expected to help reorganize urban space, improve access to public transport and enhance the efficiency of transport infrastructure. It will also provide a basis for studying connections between residential areas, economic centers and service hubs and high-capacity public transport networks. According to the funding partners, investment for construction of the extension is expected to be explored through the Team Europe cooperation mechanism, with the participation of Germany’s KfW Development Bank and cooperation with ADB. The EUR€10 million grant is specifically intended for research and project preparation, not for the total construction cost of the extension. Construction will depend on the study findings, approval procedures and capital mobilization plans in accordance with regulations. At the event, Hanoi People’s Committee Vice Chairman Truong Viet Dung stressed that the metro line is significant beyond its role as a transport project. Each new metro line not only provides a safe and convenient means of travel but also helps ease congestion, reduce environmental pollution, reorganize urban space and connect development centers. The city expressed its appreciation for support from the French Government and international financial institutions, particularly the EU’s 10-million-euro grant through AFD for studying the extension from Hanoi railway station to Hoang Mai. France's Minister Delegate for Francophonie Éléonore Caroit described Metro Line 3 as tangible evidence of the results of cooperation under the Vietnam–France Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. She also highlighted prospects for further cooperation between France, the EU and Vietnam in public transport development, including preparations to extend Metro Line 3 to Hoang Mai. Victoire Vandeville, AFD’s Regional Director for Southeast Asia, said the millions of passenger journeys recorded during the line’s first year of operation demonstrated the effectiveness of cooperation among the partners. AFD reaffirmed its readiness to continue supporting Hanoi in studying and preparing the Metro Line 3 extension with EU assistance. Scott Roberts, ADB Country Director for Vietnam, emphasized that urban railways do more than meet travel needs. They also connect people with employment, education and development opportunities. ADB pledged to continue working with Hanoi and its partners to develop an integrated and accessible urban transport network that meets the capital’s development needs. Metro Line 3 is 12.5 km long and has 12 stations, including eight elevated and four underground stations. The elevated section from Nhon to Cau Giay began commercial operations in August 2024, providing an additional high-capacity public transport option in western Hanoi. According to data from Hanoi Metro included in a statement by the international partners, the elevated section carried approximately 6.4 million passenger journeys in its first year of operation, with an on-time performance rate of 99%. Beyond its transport benefits, international partners have also highlighted the project’s contribution to reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Estimates released by the partners indicate that the line helped avoid approximately 49,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent emissions in 2025. This figure is projected to reach around 81

picked.t: France’s Alstom gets $900M order from Vingroup for Hanoi metro trains
picked.body: Vingroup, through its subsidiary Vinhomes, is constructing the new lines, which will improve connectivity with the city’s outskirts. There are currently two lines. The new routes will have a combined length of 303.5 kilometers, and their construction began in June and is expected to be finished in 2030. The new routes will link the downtown area with Noi Bai International Airport, expand connectivity with the city’s northern and southern areas and to the high-tech hub of Hoa Lac in the west. The order is for an undisclosed number of Metropolis trains that will be manufactured in Valenciennes, France, Alstomsaid in a statement Monday. The two companies signed the 200-train contract on Oct. 6 without disclosing its value. Of them, 83 will be made in France and Vingroup will assemble the remaining 117 in Vietnam. Each train will consist of five aluminum-alloy cars, a design that reduces axle loads, lower energy consumption, and minimize tracks’ wear. The trains will operate at GoA4, the highest grade of automation, allowing them to run without onboard drivers. Alstom is one of the world’s major manufacturers of trains, metro systems, and locomotives, and also supplies signaling and other railroad technologies. It has supplied rolling stock for major projects worldwide, including across Asia. It has had a presence in Vietnam for more than three decades, installing signaling systems for the Hanoi-Vinh railway and Ninh Binh station and supplying 10 trains for Hanoi’s metro line 3, which runs between Nhon and Hanoi Railway Station. Vingroup , the largest listed company in Vietnam, is controlled by Southeast Asia’s richest man, Pham Nhat Vuong, who is worth $32.4 billion, according to real-time data from Forbes.

picked.t: 호치민시 ‘사이공강 보행교’ 내년 뗏(설)연휴 개통…21일 주교량 연결
picked.body: 베트남 호치민시에 들어설 사이공강 보행교 조감도. (조감도=초다이-타카시니와아키텍트 및 초타디키소지반베트남 컨소시엄) 베트남 호치민시의 사이공강을 가로질러 도심과 투티엠(Thu Thiem)신도시를 연결하는 보행교가 이르면 내년 뗏(Tet 설) 연휴 개통될 것으로 전해졌다. 보행교의 핵심 구조물인 주교량은 지난 19일 박당부두(Bach Dang Wharf) 인근 공사 현장에 도착해 설치 작업을 앞두고 있다. 사이공강 보행교 건설사업의 후원사인 누티푸드(Nutifood)는 “21일 상판 연결 작업이 진행될 것”이라고 지난 19일 밝혔다. 누티푸드에 따르면, 사이공강 보행교의 현재 공정률은 90%에 도달한 상태로, 주교량 연결 작업이 끝나면, 시공사는 난간과 조명, 에스컬레이터·엘리베이터 설치 등 남은 작업을 마무리할 계획이다. 예상 개통 시점은 내년 뗏 연휴 중이다. 지난해 3월 착공된 사이공강 보행교는 사이공강을 가로질러 호치민시 옛 1군과 투티엠신도시를 잇는 길이 720m, 너비 6~11m, 경간 187m의 교량으로, 1조 동(약 3,850만 달러)에 달하는 사업비는 영유아식품기업 누티푸드가 후원했다 현지에서는 니파야자(Nipa palm)의 잎을 닮은 사이공강 보행교의 모양이 독특해 완공시 호치민시의 새로운 랜드마크가 될 것으로 기대를 모으고 있다. 니파야자는 꽃대가 돋아나는 모습이 죽순과 닮았다 하여 한국에서는 해죽순으로 불리기도 한다. 보행교는 탁 트인 전망으로 설계됐으며, 자전거도로와 장애인을 위한 도로를 갖췄다. 또한 긴급 상황에 대응할 수 있도록 구급차가 통행할 수 있는 도로도 갖춰진다. 사이공강 보행교를 사이공강을 가로질러 건설되는 최초의 보행자 전용 다리로, 개통 시 도심과 투티엠신도시를 잇는 새로운 경로와 함께 지역민과 관광객을 위한 강변문화공간이 보다 확대될 것으로 기대를 모은다.

picked.t: Plants wilt, 40 people hospitalized after suspected chlorine leak at Hanoi scrapyard
picked.body: The leak happened at 7 a.m. at Nguyen Huu Doan's scrap business in Thuong Phuc Commune on the city outskirts, according to the commune's People's Committee of Thuong Phuc. Doan buys gas cylinders. While the cylinders were waiting to be processed, a worker accidentally threw a piece of scrap iron onto a valve, knocking off a cylinder's cap and releasing the gas inside. The cylinders were stored on a vacant lot of more than 100 sq.m next to a residential area on Duong Truc Nguyen Street. As the gas spread, many people inhaled it and struggled to breathe. Trees and plants around the site wilted, their leaves scorched. The Hanoi police's fire prevention and rescue department sent a team to handle the incident with the commune's Military Command. Authorities at the scene mainly sprayed water over the leak area to dilute the gas, then cordoned it off. Thuong Tin General Hospital said it received 40 people with suspected gas poisoning that morning. They were workers at the scrap business and people living nearby. With so many patients arriving at once, the hospital mobilized extra doctors and nurses for its emergency department and triaged patients by severity. Two people in serious condition were transferred to the Poison Control Center at Bach Mai Hospital, and three others were receiving intensive treatment. The remaining 35 were to stay at the hospital for monitoring for at least 12 hours. By that evening, Bach Mai's Poison Control Center had received four patients from Thuong Tin, its director Nguyen Trung Nguyen said. Two of them, both men, had respiratory failure and severe airway injuries, while the other two were not in serious condition. One of the men had very severe lung damage with shock and might need ECMO, a machine that oxygenates the blood outside the body. The other had near-total damage to the cornea of his right eye, seriously threatening his sight. Leaders of the Hanoi Department of Health directed Thuong Tin General Hospital to focus all its resources on treating patients promptly and sent medical teams from Saint Paul, Duc Giang and Ha Dong hospitals to help. The department also worked with Bach Mai Hospital to give patients the best possible treatment. Police are investigating the leak. Initial information indicates the cylinder contained chlorine, an industrial chemical commonly used to disinfect tap water, treat swimming pool water and make cleaning products. In a report that evening, Hanoi police said the leak came from a chlorine cylinder in the business's scrap pile. Authorities said the owner had bought the cylinder along with scrap iron, and commune police are working with other agencies to establish its origin, the cause of the leak and who is responsible.

picked.t: Citi, Vietcombank leaders discuss financing, capital market cooperation
picked.body: A Citi delegation met Le Quang Vinh, CEO of Vietcombank, in Hanoi on Oct. 16 during a visit to Vietnam following the IMF-World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok. The delegation included Ernesto Torres Cantú, Head of International; Amol Gupte, Asia South Cluster and Banking Head; Kaustubh Kulkarni, Co-Head of Investment Banking Coverage for Japan, Asia North and Australia, and Asia South; and Minh Ngo, Vietnam Citi Country Officer and Banking Head. The discussions covered infrastructure financing, transaction banking, cash management and other financial services, as well as capital mobilization, debt capital markets and long-term financing solutions to support Vietcombank's strategic goals. Citi reaffirmed its commitment to helping Vietcombank access international capital markets and explore financing opportunities aligned with its development plans. The executives also exchanged views on global economic conditions, Vietnam's growth outlook and the banking sector. Citi shared updates on its business performance, including what it described as its strongest third-quarter revenue in a decade, and outlined its strategic priorities for Vietnam.

picked.t: Vietnam tops growth for Australian outbound travel, nearly matches UK
picked.body: Some 588,490 Australians visited Vietnam during the period, up 17.4% year on year and just 60 fewer than the 588,550 trips to the U.K., ATIA's October 2026 Travel Trends Report showed. The report draws on Australian Bureau of Statistics overseas arrivals and departures data. Vietnam's growth was particularly strong in August, when the number of trips jumped by 30.3% year on year to 45,630. ATIA director of compliance and membership Nina Hedges described Vietnam as "the one to watch," highlighting its growth and narrow gap with the U.K. "On current trends, it won't stay behind for long." Vietnam's tourism authorities have highlighted the country's accessibility and variety of experiences as attractions for Australian holidaymakers. Direct flights, shorter flights than to Europe, and the chance to combine beach holidays with local food and culture make Vietnam appealing to Australian travelers, the Vietnam National Authority of Tourism said on its website. The article highlighted central Vietnam, where visitors can combine coastal resorts with heritage attractions. It also described experiences ranging from exploring local markets to cruising through river deltas, illustrating the variety available within a single trip. Vietnam's rise is also part of the broader growth in Australians' travel to Asia. Together with China and Japan, it accounted for almost 250,000 more people compared with the previous year, according to ATIA. Meanwhile, travel to the U.K. and U.S. declined over the same period. Overall, Australians made 12.77 million overseas trips in the year to August, up 3.2%.

picked.t: 베트남, 국제 모빌리티쇼 ‘VNMS 2026’ 12월 하노이서 개최…시승·모터스포츠·가족 체험 확대
picked.body: 지난해 열린 베트남모빌리티쇼2026 행사 당시 모습. (사진=VnExpress) 베트남 대표 자동차·오토바이 전시회인 '베트남모빌리티쇼(Vietnam Mobility Show, VnMS)'가 오는 12월 5~6일 이틀간 수도 하노이에서 개최된다. 현지 매체 VN익스프레스가 주최하는 이번 행사에는 수십 개 완성차·오토바이·부품 업체가 참가하며, 시승 체험관과 모터스포츠 공연, 가족 참여 프로그램이 마련된다. 주최 측에 따르면, 이번 행사는 오는 12월 5~6일 하노이시 외곽 지역인 동안(Dong Anh) 소재 베트남전시센터에서 열린다. 올해 행사는 체험형 프로그램을 중심으로 더욱 다채롭고 다양한 콘텐츠를 준비했다는 것이 주최 측의 설명이다. 앞서 지난해 행사에는 자동차·오토바이·액세서리 브랜드 20여 곳이 참여한 바 있다. 전시장 중심부 다양한 완성차 업체와 오토바이 브랜드가 친환경 기술과 지속 가능한 모빌리티를 선보일 예정이다. 베트남에 오랜 시간 입지를 다져온 기존 제조사들은 물론, 여러 베트남 토종 브랜드도 올해 행사에 참가해 소비자들에게 제품을 선보일 예정이다. 직접 차량에 탑승해볼 수 있는 시승 체험관도 큰 관심을 끌 전망이다. 완성차 업체들은 최신 모델 100대 가까이를 준비해, 전문 드라이빙 강사가 설계한 장애물 코스와 실제 도로에서 차량을 직접 몰아볼 수 있는 기회를 제공할 예정이다. 모든 연령대의 관람객들이 가장 많이 몰릴 곳은 모터스포츠 아레나가 될 것으로 보인다. 이곳에는 수입 차량을 비롯해 현지 차주들의 △스포츠카 △슈퍼카 △커스텀 차량과 약 300대가 전시된다. 이 구역에서는 주말 내내 전문 드라이버들이 자동차 드리프트와 오토바이 스턴트 시범을 번갈아 선보인다. 주최 측에 따르면, 이번 행사는 단순한 산업 박람회를 넘어 가족이 함께 주말 나들이를 즐길 수 있는 테마로 기획됐다. 이에 따라 행사장에는 △카림픽패밀리런(the Carlympic Family Run) △어린이를 위한 체험형 교통안전 교육 놀이터 △다양한 푸드 부스가 마련된다. 메인 무대에서는 모든 세대가 참여할 수 있는 라이프스타일 세미나와 실생활에 유용한 기술 워크숍이 열린다. 차량을 꾸미려는 운전자를 위해 애프터마켓·액세서리 전시관에서는 신제품 공개와 행사 한정 할인이 진행된다. 주최 측은 “이번 박람회는 뗏(Tet 설) 쇼핑 성수기 직전에 열려, 구매자가 전시장과 시승으로 모델을 평가한 뒤 구매를 결정할 수 있는 좋은 기회가 될 것”이라 설명했다. 이 밖에도 완성차 업체들은 현장을 찾은 관람객(티켓 소지자)을 위한 전용 프로모션 할인과 금융 패키지도 준비하고 있다.

picked.t: Singapore billionaire Forrest Li's Sea plans new cloud business, IPO for financial services arm
picked.body: Sea's billionaire founder Forrest ⁠Li, in a memo sent to employees on Tuesday that was reviewed by Reuters , said he believed going public would give its financial payments and services business the "resources and the room to go further and faster than it can today." The business operates in Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, the ‌Philippines, ⁠Taiwan, and Brazil and offers mobile wallets, payments processing, credit and banking services. The memo said the ⁠tech group would also launch an AI-first enterprise platform named Sea Cloud. In the memo, which was sent on ⁠the ninth anniversary of the group’s public listing in New York , Li said the ⁠quarterly revenue for the group had grown more than 80 times over that period to US$7.8 billion.
